// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-ASSEMBLED-IDENTIFIER
// @expect: OPS-COMPUTED-SELECTION
// Valid Prisma, and it defeats whole-word matching. Nobody splits a name across
// a concatenation by accident.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function parentByEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({
    where: { email },
    select: { id: true, ["family" + "Code"]: true },
  });
}
